text.en:
Item sixteen, paragraph (s), of section one of Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and seventy,
known as the Public Works Act, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"16. For the maintenance and continuation of the Port of Calbayog, Samar P60,000.00"

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 5, 1930.
